'''Tooch''' was a pet [[Razort]] owned by [[Sedrian]] [[Karak]]. Karak had managed to tame Tooch and use him as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] despite the creature's vicious nature, and Tooch obeyed his master without question.<ref name="BGS" />
